scope_shape.name: scope_shape
scope_shape.value:
("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'platform'   and "role_assignments"."university_id" is null     and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null     and "role_assignments"."batch_id" is null)
     or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'university' and "role_assignments"."university_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null     and "role_assignments"."batch_id" is null)
     or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "role_assignments"."university_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."department_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."batch_id" is null)
     or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'batch'      and "role_assignments"."university_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null     and "role_assignments"."batch_id" is not null)

assess_tests_window.name: assess_tests_window
assess_tests_window.value: "assess_tests"."opens_at" is null or "assess_tests"."closes_at" is null or "assess_tests"."closes_at" > "assess_tests"."opens_at"

asgn_submissions_to_grade_idx.name: asgn_submissions_to_grade_idx
asgn_submissions_to_grade_idx.where: "asgn_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null and "asgn_submissions"."graded_at" is null

content_lesson_drip.name: content_lesson_drip
content_lesson_drip.value:
("content_lessons"."drip_mode" = 'none' and "content_lessons"."drip_days" is null and "content_lessons"."drip_date" is null)
     or ("content_lessons"."drip_mode" = 'after_start' and "content_lessons"."drip_days" is not null and "content_lessons"."drip_days" >= 0 and "content_lessons"."drip_date" is null)
     or ("content_lessons"."drip_mode" = 'on_date' and "content_lessons"."drip_days" is null and "content_lessons"."drip_date" is not null)
